title: How LLMs influence computer vision
reading: The slide illustrates the architecture and behaviour of a typical multimodal LLM, showing how an image and a text prompt are jointly consumed to produce a grounded natural-language answer. A worked example uses an aerial photo of the Texas A&M campus with the question about the tower building, and the model's response is shown at right, attributed to OpenAI GPT-4o.

visuals.description: Left: an input campus photo feeds a 'Vision Encoder' box producing a sequence of orange visual tokens; a 'Text Prompt: Where is the tower building in the image?' produces blue text tokens; both token sequences feed upward into a wide green 'Large Language Models' block, whose output is a speech bubble pointing to the answer panel.
visuals.assertion: A multimodal LLM works by encoding images into token embeddings that are concatenated with text prompt tokens and fed into a single LLM backbone.

visuals.description: Text panel with the model's answer identifying the tall white cylindrical building as a water tower on the Texas A&M campus bearing 'WELCOME TO AGGIELAND', located in the foreground left of center with Kyle Field behind it. Caption: 'By OpenAI GPT 4o'.
visuals.assertion: A modern multimodal LLM can identify, read text on, and spatially localize objects in an image while providing corroborating contextual reasoning.

visuals.description: Aerial photograph of the Texas A&M campus with a water tower in the foreground and a football stadium behind.
